title: pleopeltis oligolepida
intro: Pleopeltis oligolepida, commonly known as the Mexican polypody fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis oligolepida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antiparasitic activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as ursolic acid and oleanolic acid, have also been reported to possess anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties.
